svg.aria-label: ViewMapper: a blueprint of a Trino schema. Discover how your Trino views depend upon each other. General usage, simple examples. Inside a dashed parcel line, a dependency graph of eight views reads left to right: two faded upstream views feed one view, which feeds the hub, and the hub feeds two views that share a faded downstream view; the view before the hub also feeds a faded view below it. The checker circles the hub: 'start with the hub'. Sample prompts read: show me a mermaid diagram of all views related to customer_360; analyze the simple_ecommerce schema. Title block: viewmapper, revision 483, scale 500+ views, license Apache 2, dated 2026-10-12, architect robfromboulder, tested with Claude.
